newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINN CITY TO SELL WASTE SERVICES-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: TALLINN CITY TO SELL WASTE SERVICES-REPORT.

text.p: Tallinn city government will decide on Friday if it will sell off its waste collection service, Eriautobaas, Aripaev newspaper said on Thursday.
The city waste collection service contols two thirds of the Tallinn market with a turnover of 60 million kroons in 1997 but with a net profit of only 2,000 kroons, the newspaper said.
The newspaper estimated waste collection in Tallinn as being worth as much as three million kroons a month.

The proposed privisation process will create four joint stock companies: one to control the Paaskula garbage land fill, an adminstrative firm to privatise the company's real estate, a garbage truck firm and a street cleaning firm which may remain with the city, the newspaper added.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 630 8400 reuters@reut ers.ee
